summary: Debug trace entry called when restarting the special effects system. Invokes StringSplitLoop with the source path and line number 3295 as a conditional trace trigger, then writes an "entered special" message through DebugLogWrite when the trigger returns non-zero.

operations.description: Call StringSplitLoop with arguments (2, SourcePath, line 3295) to conditionally enable trace output; store result.
If the low byte of the StringSplitLoop result is non-zero, enter the debug-logging branch; otherwise skip logging.
Write the entered-special message string to the debug message buffer via DebugLogWrite and return.
Return the StringSplitLoop result unchanged when the trace branch is skipped.
